# Daily Tech Report

> 매일 오전·오후 업데이트되는 한국어 테크 큐레이션: GitHub Trending, GeekNews, AI·HCI·신경과학·인지심리·행동경제·로보틱스·계산사회과학 최신 논문 요약.

## How to Browse (For AI Agents & Non-JS Crawlers)
This site loads report fragments dynamically on the client via `app.js`. If you cannot execute JavaScript, fetch the machine-readable index first:

- Report Index (JSON): https://jukang80.github.io/daily-tech-report/reports/index.json
- Sitemap (XML): https://jukang80.github.io/daily-tech-report/sitemap.xml

Each entry in `reports/index.json` has `id`, `date`, `slot`, `title`, and `path` (a standalone HTML fragment under `reports/`).

## Structure of Each Report
1. **GitHub Trending**: 10 repositories with Korean descriptions and practical use cases.
2. **GeekNews**: 10 trending tech discussions from news.hada.io.
3. **Latest Papers**: 20 curated papers across AI, HCI, Neuroscience, Cognitive Psychology, Behavioral Economics, Robotics/BCI, Computational Social Science, and wildcards.
